# Repository Governance

This repository is an engineering and traceability surface for SIFI.

It does not authorize:

- live or recurring source acquisition;
- automatic source/evidence admission;
- CB22 counted participant sessions;
- CB22 final adjudication;
- production deployment;
- commercial activation;
- policy action.

Runtime databases, participant evidence, consent/screening records,
human-study observations, adjudication bundles, backups, logs, exports,
credentials, and secrets remain local/governed assets and must not be
committed to this repository.

Technical CI success does not constitute final analytical, research,
production, or commercial authority.
